title: Alginate Microcapsule as a 3D Platform for Propagation and Differentiation of Human Embryonic Stem Cells (hESC) to Different Lineages
protocol: Add 0.275 g of purified sodium alginate in a sterile 50 ml tube.
Add 25 ml sterile 0.1% gelatin solution to the tube.
Vortex the tube for approximately 30 seconds.
Place the tube on an orbital mixer at 10 x g overnight at room temperature.
Add 2.778 ml of 9% sterile NaCl to 25 ml of alginate solution.
Vortex the tube for approximately 30 seconds.
Centrifuge the tube at 95 x g for 5 min.
Store the alginate solution at 4 °C for short-term storage or at -20 °C for long-term storage.
Dissolve 14.7 g of CaCl2.2H2O and 2.38 g of HEPES in 1 litre of milli-Q H2O.
Adjust the pH level to 7.4.
Sterilize the solution using a 0.22 μm filter.
Store the precipitation bath at room temperature for up to 6-12 months.
In 500 ml of Dulbecco's Phosphate Buffered Saline, add 50 ml of 0.5M EDTA and 5 ml of 1M HEPES.
Sterilize using a 0.22 μm filter or autoclave at 121 °C for 20 min.
Store the decapsulating solution at room temperature (6-12 months).
Prepare SR medium in advance as described in Table of specific reagents and equipment.
Dilute Y-27632 powder in 0.1% human serum albumin (HSA) in D-PBS to make a 5 mM solution.
Pre-treat the cells with culturing media supplemented with 10 μM of ROCK inhibitor (RI) for two hours at 37 °C (protect from light).
Wash cells with D-PBS twice after RI treatment.
Dislodge the cells from culture plates enzymatically with accutase for 10 min at 37 °C.
Gently scrape the cells with the pipette or cell scraper and collect in a 15 ml tube.
Neutralize the accutase with SR medium in 1:1 ratio.
Filter the neutralized cells using a 40 μm filter and collect in a fresh 50 ml centrifuge tube.
Calculate the total number of cells in the solution using a hemacytometer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 95 x g for 5 min, then carefully discard the supernatant afterwards.
Wash the cells with pre-warmed 0.9% NaCl.
Centrifuge at 95 x g for 5 min and discard the supernatant.
Prepare a 1 ml syringe attached to a soft plastic tubing of 14G x 2" I.V. catheter.
Resuspend cells in pre-warmed alginate solution at a density of 1.25 million cells/ml alginate.
Attach the syringe containing the cell suspension to the encapsulation machine with a 10 cm gap from the collection point.
Set the syringe pump at 20 ml/hr, air flow rate at 8 L/min, and pressure at 100 kPa for capsule formation.
Collect encapsulated cells into a petri dish filled with 20 ml of pre-warmed precipitation bath for 7 min to stabilize capsules.
Transfer encapsulated cells by gentle aspiration into 50 ml centrifuge tubes filled with 20 ml of 0.9% NaCl and discard the supernatant.
Repeat washing process with 0.9% NaCl.
Resuspend encapsulated cells in pre-warmed culturing medium supplemented with RI (10 μM).
Transfer encapsulated cells into a culture flask for incubation at 37 °C/5% CO2.
Seed PA6 cells at a density of 1.0 x 10^4 per cm² in a 0.1% gelatin-coated T75 flask.
Condition the PA6 cells in DA neural differentiation medium for 24 hours.
Transfer the capsules to a 50 ml centrifuge tube and allow them to settle at the bottom of the tube.
Discard the supernatant from the capsules.
Resuspend the capsules in PA6 cell-conditioned DA neural differentiation medium.
Culture encapsulated hESCs with the PA6 cell monolayer for 28 days, changing half of the medium every other day starting on day 4.
After three weeks, supplement the DA neural differentiation medium with 100 ng/ml SHH and 100 ng/ml FGF8a for one week.
Aspirate the capsules into a 15 ml centrifuge tube and allow them to settle at the bottom of the tube.
Discard the supernatant carefully.
Wash the capsules twice with D-PBS.
Add 5 ml decapsulating solution to the capsules.
Mix the suspension thoroughly via aspiration prior to incubation at room temperature for 4-5 minutes.
Centrifuge the decapsulated cells at 95 x g for 3 minutes and discard the supernatant.
Wash the cell pellet with D-PBS followed by centrifugation at 95 x g for 3 minutes.
Repeat the washing step if necessary.
Culture decapsulated cells as a monolayer or use them for downstream analysis.
